summary: legal checked in 9 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch or rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution, keep private launch gates unchanged, keep permission outreach unsent, and permit only existing read-only evidence, measurement, repair-or-close, parked-site verification, and attribution reconciliation.

Evidence reviewed: compliance is a technical baseline only, with 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics is conditional because source permissions or collector errors remain; revenue is evidence_needed because the 2026-09-21 Amazon export reports $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; security sitefacts remain unknown. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth, but failed or unknown compliance and security evidence blocks exposure or monetization changes.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for searchwoot.com: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task is closable because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Evidence confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert permissions, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price terms, and affiliate or advertising rights. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request.

Data-use review: user alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. The purpose is operationally defined, but data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table.

Data-use review: GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Measurement-only use after an explicit analytics choice is conditionally described, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review are missing. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking or advertising.

Data-use review: operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Operational use is defined, but log fields, retention and access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, retention, access, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Both are scaffold/parked, analytics is not configured, and compliance reachability fails with network errors; audience, disclosures, consent, monetization, and operational health remain unknown. Exact decision: no launch or monetization change. Next evidence action: attach dated execution-owner verification, reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision evidence.

Human counsel is required before any Woot permission request, public display of upstream data, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising use, or rights-dependent launch decision. No go-live proposal is supported by the current evidence.
